newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville cuts Sunday power price, Mon-Tues flat.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville cuts Sunday power price, Mon-Tues flat.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) slightly lowered its price offers for Sunday, but left Monday and Tuesday offers unchanged from the levels offered all this week, the agency said Friday.
For Sunday pre-schedulings, BPA offered firm power during heavy load hours at $17.25 per megawatt hour (MWh) in the Northwest and $18.00 at the California border.
Non-Firm offers between 0900 and 2200 PDT on Sunday were offered at $17.75 for Northwest deliveries and at $18.50 at the California border.
For Monday and Tuesday, BPA continued to offer block power during heavy load hours at $18.00 per MWh in the Northwest and $19.50 at the California border.
Off-peak firm sales for all deliveries were still offered at $15.00 per MWh.
BPA continued to offer non-firm power during light load and shoulder hours for all delivery points at $15.00-16.00 for Monday and Tuesday pre-schedulings.
